rows.label: qst703205_msg0001
rows.name: What happened?

rows.label: qst703205_msg0002
rows.name: Did you get injured somewhere...?

rows.label: qst703205_msg0003
rows.name:
I did it! I finally did it!
I defeated a monster!

rows.label: qst703205_msg0004
rows.name: Rita, please calm down.

rows.label: qst703205_msg0005
rows.name:
You said 'finally'... What were you
doing until now?

rows.label: qst703205_msg0006
rows.name:
She's been dodging them all this
time. So this is her first victory.

rows.label: qst703205_msg0007
rows.name:
Kaede-chan, do you think
I've gotten stronger?

rows.label: qst703205_msg0008
rows.name:
After beating one monster?
Just listen to yourself.

rows.label: qst703205_msg0009
rows.name:
And even that looked like you tripped
and your weapon just happened to
hit it...

rows.label: qst703205_msg0010
rows.name:
Ugh... So I'm useless
after all, then...

rows.label: qst703205_msg0011
rows.name: ...Rita, take a look at that.

rows.label: qst703205_msg0012
rows.name: Whoa! Is that...Lasqam Harbor?

rows.label: qst703205_msg0013
rows.name:
It was such a huge port, but from
here it looks tiny.

rows.label: qst703205_msg0014
rows.name:
Whether you've gotten stronger or
not, I'm proud you made it this far.

rows.label: qst703205_msg0015
rows.name: K-Kaede-chan~~!

rows.label: qst703205_msg0016
rows.name:
What's that face you're
pulling? Seriously...

rows.label: qst703205_msg0017
rows.name:
Seriously. All this noise about
a simple exploration mission.

rows.label: qst703205_msg0018
rows.name:
Everyone starts like that. Thinking
back to when we first met, this is
plenty of progress.

rows.label: qst703205_msg0019
rows.name:
Rita might make a surprisingly good
Driver.

rows.label: qst703205_msg0020
rows.name:
It's rare for Shin to praise someone
like that, isn't it?

rows.label: qst703205_msg0021
rows.name:
Maybe you'll really become a big-name
Driver someday.

rows.label: qst703205_msg0022
rows.name:
...Everyone. Thank you
for all your assistance.

rows.label: qst703205_msg0023
rows.name:
After we've gone around
Gula, I think we'll find
some other place to explore.

rows.label: qst703205_msg0024
rows.name:
Then we might meet again
somewhere, mightn't we?

rows.label: qst703205_msg0025
rows.name:
Then next time, we'll have the future
big-shot Driver help us out.

rows.label: qst703205_msg0026
rows.name: Ohhh... Don't make fun of me!

rows.label: qst703205_msg0027
rows.name:
But really, I'm looking forward to it.
I'm cheering for you two.
